message: The toilets on level 2 keep running non-stop and the floor is wet.
Projectors in every lecture theatre are left switched on over the weekend.
Someone threw food scraps in the paper-only recycling again.
There is a burning smell from the kitchen switchboard.
The wheelchair ramp is fine now, thanks for fixing it so fast!
A contractor we hired seems to be dumping offcuts illegally.
Our ESG report double-counts the solar offsets and nobody wants to fix it.
Water is pooling under the sink in the Building D kitchen.
The stairlift to the library mezzanine has been out of order since Monday.
Great job on cutting energy use this quarter.
